sources.entry: Hubleys - Personal dashboards to organize links for multiple users via a central yaml config. MIT Docker

summary.one_liner: Hubleys is a self-hosted, Docker-based personal dashboard that gives multiple users their own set of predefined links, search engines, events and messages, configured centrally in a YAML file.
summary.what_it_does: Hubleys generates a separate dashboard for each user based on their groups and permissions, with all content predefined by admins in a central config.yml. Dashboard features listed include link tiles organized into folders, search engines with autocomplete, upcoming calendar events, and messages shown to users. It also offers customizable backgrounds (including a wallpaper collection and Unsplash images), current weather and forecast via OpenWeatherMap, and clock, stopwatch and timer widgets. User identity comes from forward auth HTTP headers (Remote-User, Remote-Groups, Remote-Name, Remote-Email) set by a reverse proxy and auth provider. Persistent data lives under /data, and users can save their own settings and uploaded backgrounds.
use_cases: share a set of self-hosted service links with multiple users
give each user a dashboard based on their group membership
central start page for a家庭 or team homelab
show announcements or messages on a shared start page
start page with weather, clock and calendar events
dashboard behind Authelia or Caddy forward auth
how_to_run: Create a docker-compose.yml using image ghcr.io/knrdl/hubleys-dashboard with ADMINS, OPENWEATHERMAP_API_KEY and UNSPLASH_API_KEY environment variables and a ./data:/data volume
Edit ./data/config.yml to define dashboard contents, then restart the application
Configure a reverse proxy (Caddy or Nginx examples given) with an auth provider such as Authelia to pass Remote-User and related headers
Connect the container to the proxy network and proxy to port 3000
notable: Per-user dashboards driven by group membership from forward-auth headers
All dashboard content predefined by admins in one config.yml, reloadable without restart via admin settings
Demo runs with a single docker run command in single-user mode
Customizable and dynamic backgrounds, including a local wallpaper folder
Users can save their own settings and upload backgrounds
caveats: Requires a reverse proxy and an auth provider sending Remote-User headers; no built-in login
Weather and Unsplash backgrounds need API keys and do not work in the demo
Config changes need an application restart or the admin reload action
